title: Design System: Takara — Tropical Green Paradise

nativeFont.stack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
nativeFont.apple: San Francisco provided by the operating system

transactionHistory.heading: Indonesian month and year with filtered transaction count
transactionHistory.search: Borderless input within shared rounded 28px search/filter surface
transactionHistory.saveAndContinue: 48px circular plus, accessible name, spinner while saving

components.name: Record action
components.description: Mint capsule on the home balance panel.
components.css: .ds-record{font-family:var(--font-ui,-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:#06D6A0;color:#073B4C;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff80}.ds-record:hover{filter:brightness(.98)}.ds-record:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-record:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #073B4C;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Icon-only 56px floating recording action on Beranda, Transaksi, and Dompet.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" aria-label="Tambah transaksi"><svg width="25" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary{border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#073B4C;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:56px;height:56px;padding:0;font:600 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;box-shadow:0 6px 24px -9px #243d4560}.ds-primary:hover{background:#0c5569}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #073B4C;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Search
components.description: Capsule search in the daily ledger; real filtering is supplied by the app.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input type="search" aria-label="Cari catatan harian" placeholder="Cari transaksi…"></label>
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:0 17px;min-height:48px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 16px -12px #073b4c30,inset 0 0 0 1px #e0edf1;color:#5692a6}.ds-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--ink,#073B4C);font:14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-search:hover{background:#ffffffb8}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #073B4C;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Glass card
components.css: .ds-card{padding:16px;border:1px solid #d9e9ee;border-radius:24px;background:var(--glass,rgba(255,255,255,.86));color:var(--ink,#073B4C);font:15px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-card p{color:var(--muted,#365664);margin:8px 0 0}

components.name: Date capsule
components.description: Date grouping label; not an interactive filter.
components.css: .ds-date{margin:0;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:#e5f5f8;color:#073B4C;font:650 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}

components.name: Floating dock
components.description: Five-item capsule dock. Preview uses a house glyph; application uses distinct Lucide icons per destination.
components.css: .ds-dock{display:flex;max-width:560px;padding:8px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#ffffffed,#eaf7fae6);backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(1.1);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #fff,0 8px 28px -12px #355a6735}.ds-dock button{display:flex;flex:1;min-width:0;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;min-height:58px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:#457687;font:500 10px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease}.ds-dock button[aria-current=page]{background:#d9f1f3;color:#073B4C;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #ffffff80}.ds-dock button:hover{background:#daf0eb}.ds-dock button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #073B4C;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Shared field
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;color:#365664;font:13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #d9e9ee;border-radius:18px;background:var(--glass,rgba(255,255,255,.86));color:var(--ink,#073B4C);font:15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#aaded1}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #073B4C;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Wallet section tabs
components.description: Equal-width vertical Aset, Utang, and Pemasukan navigation with separate counts.

narrative.overview: Airy household finance with white/cyan glass, a navy balance panel, native system typography, and distinct pinned Tropical accents. Full rounding and readable live financial data remain central. Historical sage screenshots do not validate the current refinement; no new rendered visual pass was available and the earlier comparison gate remains open.
keyCharacteristics: White/cyan translucent material and dark navy balance.
Mint, teal, pink, and yellow accents with distinct roles.
Rounded controls, a 56px floating plus, and vertical wallet tabs.
Native system font stack and Lucide outline icons.

rules.name: Tropical Roles
rules.body: Use white/cyan for the ground, navy for balance and text, and pinned Tropical accents for actions and semantic highlights; avoid monotone green.

dos: Do preserve exact saved category backgrounds and real financial data.
Do preserve safe-area clearance and visible keyboard focus.
Do use native San Francisco on Apple and native system fallback elsewhere.
donts: Do not bundle unlicensed font files.
Do not claim static or integration checks are browser visual validation.
Do not treat the historical sage comp as current color authority.
